subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): add optional CliBackendPlugin.estimateUsage hook for text-output backends

question: Should heuristic CLI usage estimates use the existing `CliOutput.usage` channel with a preserved `estimated` discriminator, or a separate estimate/source-aware channel before exposing `CliBackendPlugin.estimateUsage`?
rationale: This is a new public plugin SDK hook and it affects session/status/cost accounting semantics; automation can point out the drop, but maintainers need to choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Use usage channel with preserved marker
options.body: Keep the additive hook shape only after the `estimated` marker survives normalized usage, session/status/cost consumers, docs, and tests.

options.title: Create a separate estimate channel
options.body: Avoid mixing heuristic estimates with provider usage by adding a distinct usage-estimate path and updating consumers to render it separately.

options.title: Pause the API
options.body: Leave the draft blocked until the canonical issue decides whether heuristic CLI usage belongs in core SDK surface at all.

recommendation.title: Use usage channel with preserved marker
recommendation.body: Keep the additive hook shape only after the `estimated` marker survives normalized usage, session/status/cost consumers, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the CLI backend type split and Gemini CLI usage parsing, which are the exact API and accounting seams in question.
